responsibility: This is the main option table for the NDS32 backend. It declares target command-line switches, aliases, enums, defaults, and backend variables for ABI selection, endianness, ISA and CPU choice, code generation extensions, scheduling and register-port tuning, ISR and cache parameters, FPU configuration, relaxation, alignment, and miscellaneous target behaviors, making it the primary specification from which GCC generates NDS32 option parsing support.
same_name_distinction: Within the nds32 same-name set, this file is the option-specification source: it declares -m target switches, enums, aliases, masks, and backing variables from which GCC generates NDS32 option parsing, rather than implementing backend behavior directly like nds32.cc, defining target macros like nds32.h, or describing RTL patterns like nds32.md.
